using namespace std;

constexpr int MOD = 1000000007;
constexpr int MAX_N = 1 << 20;

int modPow(int base, int exp) {
    int result = 1;
    base %= MOD;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) result = (1LL * result * base) % MOD;
        base = (1LL * base * base) % MOD;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

constexpr int MAX_M = 21;

int nVal;
int fArr[MAX_N], gArr[MAX_N];
int prob[MAX_M][MAX_M];

int indexTable[2][MAX_N];
int reverseMap[MAX_N];
int matchedArr[MAX_M];
int adjacency[MAX_M][MAX_M];

void process(int *dst, const vector<int>& left, const vector<int>& right, const vector<int>& subgraphs, int *indexMap) {
    vector<pair<int, int>> edgeList;
    for (int u : left) {
        for (int v : right) {
            edgeList.emplace_back(u, v);
        }
    }

    int edgeCount = edgeList.size();
    for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << edgeCount); ++mask) {
        long long weight = 1;
        int newMask = 0;

        for (int i = 0; i < edgeCount; ++i) {
            int u = edgeList[i].first, v = edgeList[i].second;
            if (mask & (1 << i)) {
                weight = (weight * prob[u][v]) % MOD;
                adjacency[u][v] = 1;
            } else {
                weight = (weight * ((1 - prob[u][v] + MOD) % MOD)) % MOD;
                adjacency[u][v] = 0;
            }
        }

        for (int gr : subgraphs) {
            vector<int> perm, idxList;
            for (int x : left) perm.push_back(x);
            for (int i = 0; i < nVal; ++i) {
                if (gr & (1 << i)) {
                    idxList.push_back(i + nVal);
                }
            }

            bool found = false;
            sort(idxList.begin(), idxList.end());
            do {
                bool ok = true;
                for (size_t i = 0; i < perm.size(); ++i) {
                    if (!adjacency[perm[i]][idxList[i]]) {
                        ok = false;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (ok) {
                    found = true;
                    break;
                }
            } while (next_permutation(idxList.begin(), idxList.end()));

            if (found) {
                newMask |= (1 << indexMap[gr]);
            }
        }

        dst[newMask] = (dst[newMask] + static_cast<int>(weight)) % MOD;
    }
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    cin >> nVal;
    for (int i = 0; i < nVal; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < nVal; ++j) {
            int temp;
            cin >> temp;
            prob[i][j + nVal] = static_cast<int>(1LL * temp * modPow(100, MOD - 2) % MOD);
        }
    }

        return 0;
    }

    int rightSize = nVal - leftSize;

    int count1 = 0, count2 = 0;
    vector<int> subset1, subset2;

    for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << nVal); ++mask) {
        if (__builtin_popcount(mask) == leftSize) {
            indexTable[0][mask] = count1++;
            subset1.push_back(mask);
        }
        if (__builtin_popcount(mask) == rightSize) {
            indexTable[1][mask] = count2++;
            subset2.push_back(mask);
        }

        int mask = subset2[i];
        int complement = ((1 << nVal) - 1) ^ mask;
        reverseMap[(1 << count2) - 1 - (1 << i)] |= (1 << indexTable[0][complement]);
    }

    vector<int> leftPart1, leftPart2, rightPart;
    for (int i = nVal; i < 2 * nVal; ++i) rightPart.push_back(i);
    for (int i = 0; i < leftSize; ++i) leftPart1.push_back(i);
    for (int i = leftSize; i < nVal; ++i) leftPart2.push_back(i);

    process(fArr, leftPart1, rightPart, subset1, indexTable[0]);
    process(gArr, leftPart2, rightPart, subset2, indexTable[1]);

    int totalSubsets = 1 << count1;
    for (int i = 0; i < count1; ++i) {
        for (int mask = 0; mask < totalSubsets; ++mask) {
            if (mask & (1 << i)) {
                fArr[mask] = (fArr[mask] + fArr[mask ^ (1 << i)]) % MOD;
            }
        }
    }

    long long answer = 0;
    int totalSubsets2 = 1 << count2;
    for (int mask = 1; mask < totalSubsets2; ++mask) {
        int comp = totalSubsets2 - 1 - mask;
        int revMask = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < count2; ++i) {
            if (comp & (1 << i)) revMask |= (1 << reverseMap[comp]);
        }
        int invComp = totalSubsets - 1 - revMask;
        int weight = (1 - fArr[invComp] + MOD) % MOD;
        answer = (answer + 1LL * weight * gArr[mask]) % MOD;
    }

    cout << answer;
    return 0;
